intent: Fail closed on production runtime HTTP listen addresses that would expose the current plaintext server outside loopback. Full TLS serving is deliberately out of scope for this slice.
invariants: The current runtime HTTP server may bind only to loopback until it actually serves TLS.
Malformed listen addresses fail startup validation before application side effects.
Wildcard, unspecified, LAN and arbitrary hostname binds fail with the explicit insecure-remote-bind classification.
No certificate/TLS configuration is added unless the production listener consumes and verifies it.
contracts: localhost, IPv4 loopback and IPv6 loopback are accepted.
malformed host:port returns a validation error distinct from ErrInsecureRemoteBind.
acceptance_evidence: table tests cover localhost, 127/8 and ::1 acceptance
table tests reject 0.0.0.0, ::, LAN addresses, arbitrary hostname and empty-host wildcard
malformed host:port is rejected without being misclassified
Gremlins critical-diff campaign kills mutations that weaken the remote-bind guard
repository ci/security/mutation workflows pass on the pushed commit
